_description: The valley map, as a grid of letters (one string per row, all rows the same length). Each letter is a tile; 'legend' says what each letter is. Ground (walkable): grass, flowers, dirt (cleared land), road (asphalt; make roads 2 tiles wide so the lane lines draw), sidewalk, bridge (a road over the river), path (golden footpath). water = the river (not walkable). 1-tile things that block walking: alex-mailbox (Alex's own), tree-pine, tree-oak, bush, rock, stump, fence, well, trash-can, mailbox, bench, stop-sign, street-sign, lamp, hydrant. Bigger things fill a block of their letter: car 2 wide × 1 tall; cottage (Alex's house), house, house-modern, house-tall 3 × 2; shop 4 × 2; town-hall 8 × 3; data-center 9 × 3. Houses, shops, cars, bins and mailboxes pick their colors from where they stand, so neighbors look different. To move something, edit the letters (keep blocks the right size). 'spawn' = where Alex starts (column, row; 0 = left/top). 'hotspots' = the '!' markers: 'id' (unique, remembers what was read), 'popup' (an id in popups.json), 'x'/'y' (column/row of a walkable tile), 'countsTowardCompletion' (default true). 'indicator' = what floats above it: "!" (default) or "-$" (money owed). 'area' (optional) = a tile kind (e.g. "water") that makes every tile of that kind part of the hotspot; they glow in 'highlightColor' when Alex is near. A hotspot may stand on a blocked tile (a mailbox, the river) if a walkable tile is right next to it. 'music' = track in audio.json. 'effects' = atmosphere, in order: {"type":"desaturate","amount":0–1} mutes colors; {"type":"smog","source":"data-center","radius":tiles,"maxAlpha":0–1,"color":"#rrggbb"} haze that thickens near the source; {"type":"overcast","clouds":count,"alpha":0–1} cloud shadows. 'dryness' = grass yellows and thins within 'radius' tiles of 'source'. 'npcs' = neighbors who walk slowly around: 'look' (0–9, a built-in neighbor), 'mood' ("sad" = frown and rain cloud, "angry" = tight mouth and red anger mark), 'x'/'y' (a walkable start tile), 'wander' (how many tiles from there they roam). They cough when Alex walks past.
